card.title: The Plan Gets Better
card.instruction: Celebrate every setback as proof that the scheme is becoming more sophisticated, selective, or impossible to detect.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only six people cracked our supper-club invitation. Excellent: a more selective table.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Five thought it was a puzzle night. They've cancelled.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful. We've filtered out everyone who wasn't committed to dinner.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The last one's the printer asking to be paid.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: An invitation-only dinner with our sole supplier. It's become a private partnership event.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 few respondents mean selectivity; A3 cancellations mean commitment filtering and A5 a creditor becomes a private partnership.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 five cancelled leads A3 a filter claim; B4 printer seeking payment leads A5 supplier-only event positioning.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 correct A's interpretation with practical attendance and payment information.

heightening.evidence: B4 leaves no genuine diner; A5 treats a collection visit as the scheme's most exclusive form.
